source:
@@U02737@@
And still they come!
How will I survive this?
V’ll have to resort to telling the truth!
What a coward’s way out for the Devil!
It’s getting desperate!
O Mothers, Mothers! Let 浮士德 go!

@@U02738@@
(Looking around.)

@@U02739@@
The candles are burning dimmer now,
and all at once the court begins to move,
winding its decorous procession
through long corridors and distant galleries.
Splendid!
They're now filing into the old Hall of the Knights,
which, for all its size, can scarcely contain them.
Tapestries cover its ancient wide walls,
every niche and corner
decorated with suits of armor.
No need of magic words here, I dare say.
The spirits will find the way by themselves.

@@U02741@@
Dim illumination.
The EMPEROR and the COURT have entered.

@@U02743@@
My accustomed office is to announce the play,
but not tonight; secret forces are at work here,
spirit antics causing such confusion
that reason cannot explain on rational grounds.
The chairs are arranged and in order,
the Emperor seated facing the wall,
enjoying scenes of great battles on the tapestries.
So here they sit,
translation:
@@U02737@@
但他们还是来了！
我将如何生存？
V必须诉诸说实话！
对于魔鬼来说，这是多么懦夫的出路啊！
越来越绝望了！
噢，母亲们，母亲们！让浮士德走吧！

@@U02738@@
（环顾四周。）

@@U02739@@
蜡烛现在已经熄灭了，
突然法庭开始移动，
蜿蜒其优雅的游行队伍
穿过长长的走廊和遥远的画廊。
灿烂！
他们现在正鱼贯进入旧骑士大厅，
尽管其规模如此之大，但几乎无法容纳它们。
古老宽阔的墙壁上覆盖着挂毯，
每个利基和角落
装饰着盔甲。
我敢说，这里不需要魔法词。
灵魂会自己找到路。

@@U02741@@
昏暗的照明。
皇帝和朝廷已入。

@@U02743@@
我习惯的办公室是宣布这部剧，
但今晚不行；秘密部队在这里活动，
精神滑稽动作造成如此混乱
这个理由无法用理性的理由来解释。
椅子摆放整齐，
皇帝面壁而坐，
欣赏挂毯上的伟大战斗场景。
所以他们坐在这里，
